name: Going Somewhere
source:
"The people you meet wandering these roads...
The ones who travel even in weather like this...
They must be doing something important, right?"

[From [url=http://neotable.blogspot.com/p/going-somewhere.html]The Neotable[/url]]
translation:
“你在这些路上遇到的那些闲逛的人……
即使在这样的天气下仍然旅行的人……
他们一定是在做一些重要的事情吧？”

[来自[url=http://neotable.blogspot.com/p/going-somewhere.html]新表[/url]]
